## About
Gardner Paint & Body is a family-owned shop run by David Gardner. He started out in Kansas working on his own car and helping his dad, then worked as a new car warranty painter for a Chevrolet dealership before opening his own body shop.
After moving to Texas, David built a business around autobody repair and paint. His interest in race cars led to race car repair, fabrication and custom painting. Today, with help from his family, he builds specialty items for customers throughout the country.
We work on everyday cars, custom vehicles and race cars, and we'll paint just about anything. Our customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 73 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: Expert collision repair for your car.
- Quality paint: We use only the best quality paints for gloss and durability.
- Free estimate: We'll meet you and learn about the history of your car, then prepare an estimate.
- Custom painting and airbrush work: Custom paint, including airbrush work.
- Fiberglass and carbon fiber repairs: We repair fiberglass and carbon fiber.
- Vehicle restoration: A full range of bumper to bumper restoration work.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We're approved by most insurance companies.

Q: What forms of payment do you accept?
A: We accept cash or check only. We don't take credit cards.

Q: Do you stand behind your work?
A: Yes. We warranty our work for at least a year.
